units: <cite ref="Megillah 16b:9">Meg. 16ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Esther 8:17">Esth. VIII, 17</cite>) <he>וִי׳ אלו תפלין</he> ‘and dignity (distinction)’ that means the T’fillin.
